import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { UserHttpService } from 'src/app/user-http.service'; import { AirlinesService } from 'src/app/services/airlines.service'; import { TicketsService, Tickets } from 'src/app/services/tickets.service'; import { Aircrafts } from 'src/app/services/aircrafts.service'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; @Component({ selector: 'app-dashboard', templateUrl: './dashboard.component.html', styleUrls: ['./dashboard.component.css'] }) export class DashboardComponent implements OnInit { adminRole = false; airlineRole = false; passengerRole = false; aircrafts: Aircrafts[] = []; tickets: Tickets[] = []; updateData: { name: string, revenue: number, aircrafts: Aircrafts[] } = { name: '', revenue: 0, aircrafts: [] }; constructor( private us: UserHttpService, private airlinesService: AirlinesService, private ticketsService: TicketsService, private router: Router ) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.adminRole = this.us.is_admin(); this.airlineRole = this.us.is_airline(); this.passengerRole = this.us.is_passenger(); if (this.airlineRole) { const email = this.us.get_mail(); /*this.airlinesService.getAirlineByMail(email).subscribe({ next: res => { console.log("Airline data:", res); this.aircrafts = res.aircrafts || []; }, error: err => { console.error("Errore caricamento airline:", err); } });*/ /*this.airlinesService.getAircraft().subscribe(res => { this.aircrafts = res; })*/ this.airlinesService.getAirlineByMail(email).subscribe({ next: res => { console.log("Airline data:", res); this.updateData = { name: res.name || '', revenue: res.revenue || 0, aircrafts: res.aircrafts || [] }; this.aircrafts = res.aircrafts || []; }, error: err => { console.error("Errore caricamento airline:", err); } }); this.ticketsService.getTickets().subscribe(res => { console.log('Biglietti ricevuti:', res); // Debug temporaneo this.tickets = res; }); } } logout() { this.us.logout(); this.router.navigate(['/search']); } } /*updateAirlineInfo() { const email = this.us.get_mail(); const data = { name: this.updateData.name, revenue: this.updateData.revenue }; this.airlinesService.updateAirlines(email, data).subscribe({ next: res => { console.log('Airline aggiornata:', res); // Aggiorna localmente in caso di cambiamenti this.updateData.name = res.name; this.updateData.revenue = res.revenue; }, error: err => { console.error('Errore aggiornamento airline:', err); } }); }*/
